artifact_kind: SP2 synthetic policy binding draft; data only, no canonical wire schema

D3.1.verbatim:
**D3.1 Synthetic programme set.**
- **A (recommended).** Six synthetic programmes: the three asset models (property equity, property-backed debt, receivables; PPR §4) each run as one accredited-only and one retail-permitted programme (PPR §2 "Support accredited-only and retail-permitted offerings separately").
  - The closure plans split so that both are exercised for every asset model: the accredited programmes use burn-and-retire, and the retail programmes use preserve-and-close (PPR §2 closure-plan rules).
  - Effect: every entitlement model, both investor classes and both closure plans are covered.

D3.2.verbatim:
**D3.2 Synthetic jurisdictions.**
- **A (recommended).** Adopt the ten proposed state labels of PPR §2 (US-CA, US-NY, US-TX, US-FL, US-DE, US-IL, US-MA, US-NJ, US-WA, US-CO) as synthetic fixture labels only.
  - The producer sets each programme's allowed and disallowed labels per test, as labelled experimental values.
  - Tests cover allowed and disallowed states, conflicting evidence, state changes, policy versions and evasion attempts (PPR §2).
  - No state law is asserted.

D3.3.verbatim:
**D3.3 Synthetic actors and authority rosters.**
- **A (recommended).** One synthetic actor per required function in PPR §10: compliance/admission, SPV management, ownership-record administration, custody/payment operations, independent approvers, auditor, and technical incident/release owner.
  - Rosters are sized at the adopted D01 floors, plus one spare member per class for rotation, loss and compromise tests.
  - All keys and identities are synthetic. As Plan L610 says, "a synthetic signature cannot establish real signer independence"; real OD-02 appointments stay separate (SP2-03 Notes).

root_holder_guardian_boundary: Programme roster numbers do not apply to technical roots, holder/issuer native authentication, guardians or possession proofs; retain their independent native/approved rules.
fixed_guarantees: Full investor-claim fulfilment before every burn; absent or partial evidence is not fulfilment.
Qualified secondary buyers and separate accredited-only/retail-permitted programmes.
USA business scope and synthetic state labels are off-chain programme facts, never US law hardcoded into consensus.
Closure-plan equality, liveness, flag, native guardian semantics, D19 purpose classification and all other native guards remain.
Real signer/controller independence and OD-02 appointments are not proven by synthetic IDs or signatures.
